name: My Pet Lenna
source:
Princess Lena goes to the Temple of the Wind according to her father's will.
However, Lena gets kidnapped by two goblins and is deprived of her virginity. After that Lena finally gets help and arrives at the Temple of the Wind. But she does not yet know what tragedy awaits her there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
莉娜公主按照父亲的遗愿前往风之神殿。
然而，莉娜被两个妖精绑架，并被剥夺了童贞。之后莉娜终于得到了帮助并到达了风之神殿。但她还不知道那里等待着她的是什么悲剧。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
